scope: Market aggregation, retained index windows, input and worker transport, transaction and entry boundaries; static source only.

additional_rows.contract: ContextVar token restored in finally; emit to scoped sink or flushed stderr; duration rounded for output only. Timed stage starts before protected work, adds elapsed milliseconds and emits completion in finally including work failure; telemetry exceptions are not blanket suppressed.

Use spec_from_file_location; absent spec/loader raises RuntimeError; register module by spec name before exec_module; engine wrapper fixes reaction_engine name. No independent proof of loaded external module contents.

Cache epoch→Asia/Tehran local naive datetime, local→int timestamp by replacing tzinfo with Tehran, and parsed display string→epoch. Native datetime path bypasses display string parsing. No interpolation or timezone conversion of already-local naive values.

Traverse supplied row order; int timestamp; normalize OHLC; consecutive equal lower time keeps open, max high, min low, latest close. Main key floor(timestamp/timeframe)*timeframe except TF1; lower_only skips main update. Optional tails mutated by reference; no global sort, no synthetic slots; equal extremes keep first argument.

Per-batch cache key (type,value) preserves first normalized representation for equal typed values; as_decimal on miss only. Key equality is not decimal lexeme identity; no binary float introduced by this function.

BucketAppend stores dirty and exclusive settled counts. Exact int positive TF required; TF1 aliases lower/main; persistent typed-price cache and nullable last timestamp. append delegates to staged context.

Empty rows yield unchanged dirty lengths. For nonempty, first timestamp determines lower rewind iff equal previous last; main rewind iff same aligned last bucket and nonshared; copy mutable tails before aggregation; TF1 dirty main=dirty lower.

Checked iterator requires int-converted time equal original numeric value, positive and nondecreasing; equal permitted here. Persistent cache precedes private price additions; aggregate privately using copied tails; no accepted suffix mutation during input validation.

Snapshot old suffixes and last time; commit price additions, suffixes and time before yielding delta. BaseException during yield/delta restores both suffixes (shared once), previous time and deletes new keys; earlier commit assignments outside try. Settled=max(0,len−1) exclusive, final bucket mutable.

Enumerate normalized bucket positions starting at supplied index; use engine Candle and classify_candle_color, Tehran naive stamp/display; retain Decimal OHLC references; no independent validity or price repair.

Keep lower/main candle lists and indexes plus closed-regime owner. Rebuild dirty suffix, or from zero if no index; replace index when absent or over capacity with retain_crossings=True, else refresh_suffix. TF1 shares views/index. Refresh delegates stricter native validity; outer continuation discards views on protected failure.

Bundle selected engines and optional primary; MarketContext is frozen container retaining full lower/main lists, index and chronology, visible bounds, offset and initial trend flags. Container freezing does not freeze underlying lists.

Retain candles, slice times, logical half-open length; flatten nested window to original base plus accumulated offset. First queries clamp left/right, empty returns None, translate hits back (zero valid). Extreme queries reject invalid bounds, preserve base Decimal and tie/position.

Require nonempty existing main [start,stop); lower bounds via bisect at first main and exclusive next-main/end+TF. Slice and reindex unless indexed mode with zero corresponding offset; register prepared lower/main windows in indexed mode. Fresh chronology, local visible intersection, accumulated offset; initial flags inherited only at zero unless explicit override.

Required reaction/blue/A/S engine paths, data, timeframe, from/to and direction; optional E/lifecycle paths; blue/A/S/PL-PH default enabled, bridge output opt-in, raw timeframe default1. Validate both timeframes >=1; no from/to ordering check in parser.

Load reaction/blue/A/S modules; E only if path provided. Lifecycle loads given path or fixed native fallback even without explicit flag; primary fixed path only if pl_ph enabled (getattr fallback disabled). Bundle retains exact selected engine objects.
Timed full file read; remove one UTF8 BOM prefix; json.loads parse_float=Decimal, default integers; delegate full rows. This contract derived from source, no payload accessed.
Requested range is presentation only; use full input unchanged, reject falsy rows, aggregate lower_only for TF1, then construct market context. No calculation truncation or sorting.

Batch builds lower candles/shared lower index then main (TF1 alias) and fresh chronology. Live requires delta; update views then register prepared indexes lower/main and construct fresh chronology. Index identity checked by native provider; no rollback inside this helper.

Use lower buckets at TF1, main otherwise; align both requested times by floor except TF1. bisect_left start and end+TF minus1; reject empty before clamping end to final candle. Return full arrays with local display bounds; raw timeframe not used to expand slots.

Mutable PipelineState holds per-direction native results/full accepted and candidate sets, invalid identities, detectors, initial geometry, primary and optional live_stages. FullDirectionState retains authoritative owner data including initial S and default empty StopAll list; no new behavior acceptance in declarations.

Clear three timestamp caches and optional native market indexes before protected work and in finally; no blanket exception suppression. calculate_live_from_raw delegates common runner with fresh row-derived context. Prior CP323-P29 covers bucket entry/active no-live dispatch.

After successful calculation emit pipeline completion; compact JSON encoding, encoding completion and print; return0. Module entry raises SystemExit(main()); ordinary Exception sends JSON error and exit1. Not blanket BaseException handling.

LiveRawChanged and LiveRawDeltaMismatch distinct ValueError subclasses; decode parse_float=Decimal; require nonempty list else RAW_CHANGED, native parser exceptions propagate; no independent sort/row checks.

Bisect original on selected first time; if lists not same object require equality with original slice; keep suffix catchup and original last time. Store prefix before last closing bracket using SHA-256 state plus ending; file digest copies hash before adding suffix. No separate bracket-not-found guard.

Require retained base digest and leading comma; clone prefix hash, verify proposed full hash using retained ending before decode/pipeline. Decode bracketed new rows then append; only on success advance byte end, prefix and raw digest; mismatch raises distinct recoverable exception.

Require file longer than prefix end and exact prefix hash. Strip leading tail whitespace; comma suffix decoded as array, closing bracket with trailing whitespace permits no rows, otherwise changed. Pipeline called before checkpoint advances; new rows remember entire new prefix, suffix-only change updates ending/digest.

New times strictly greater than retained original last and predecessor as supplied, unlike low-level nondecreasing gate. Append catchup+new rows (even empty); clear catchup and update last only after success; no metadata advance on downstream failure.
Compact JSON flushed on stdout; type field precedes fields (can be overwritten by fields). Progress forwards started or completedStages-bearing events only; native IO/encoding errors propagate.

Parse CLI, require original path env, read/decode selected; same path reuses data/list else read/decode original separately. Construct lineage and continuation using loaded engines; send seed ready and selected payload; delete local input references.
Read header up to256 bytes; require newline; parse JSON, exact positive int bytes and string digest len64 (no hex test). Read exact body length; only progress is True enables scoped progress output.

Non-null base digest selects delta; mismatch sends RAW_DELTA_MISMATCH and continues. Full hash mismatch sends RAW_RETRY and continues. Else append full; success sends update and deletes local payload/raw. No execution of these branches during audit.

LiveRawChanged emits RAW_CHANGED and returns1; other Exception logs stderr and emits generic LIVE_ENGINE_FAILED then returns1. EOF returns0, module exit main; BaseException not covered by ordinary handlers.

retained_prior_boundaries.contract: Closed-regime cache consults previous map only for settled absolute excluded end; publish current map only after successful stage. No duplicate count.
Bucket replay stages closed prefix cache; common runner does not supply live detector continuation to prepare_pipeline_state. CLI calculation likewise fresh.
Active wrapper prevalidates nondecreasing integer-valued times, stages buckets, resets views on protected BaseException, returns payload only after success.
Reversal prefix resolution uses independent segments and authoritative Primary3 proof.

cross_owner_handoffs.contract: Native refresh requires 0<=first<=old length<=new length<=capacity; no-op at first==length; clears crossing history only when first<old length−1. Bridge capacity gate alone is not sufficient.
Crossing history keyed by left/level/exclusion; retain settled hit or examined prefix only, latest candle remains reevaluable; FIFO eviction by configured limit. No claim of arbitrary edit safety.
Prepared index accepted only for identical source sequence; otherwise identity-keyed shared index. Cached prepared registration is process-local.
Global clear releases all three caches; per-sequence release removes only identity entries, not necessarily independently owned retained view objects.
Fresh MarketChronology retains supplied indexes and initializes empty confirmation/reset/extremes caches; retained index history not equivalent to retained detector state.

qualifications: No RAW payload read, runtime execution, ZIP, production changes or broad equivalence claims.
Typed cache equality does not preserve separate equal Decimal exponents; preserve first normalized representation exactly as source.
Active live worker replays trading stages fresh; optional detector continuations are not asserted active. Closed-regime reuse is separate.
W2 closure is not asserted by this partition; independent census and gap assessment required.
